description: This Python source file defines functions related to managing environment variable mappings for different frameworks using YAML templates. It includes functions for fetching template paths, parsing templates, applying prefixes, and mapping environment variables between common and framework-specific names.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Returns the Path object to the environment template file for a specified framework.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file, extracting an optional prefix and a mapping dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Applies a given prefix to all environment variable keys in a provided dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of common environment variables to framework-specific ones based on the template mappings and prefix.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a framework-specific environment variable dictionary back to common environment variables.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Discovers available frameworks by inspecting directories containing environment template files.
